name: brand-design
description: Build and evaluate brands grounded in cultural authority — strategy, identity, voice, and stewardship — across three seats: an aspirational Muse (the gravitational pull toward an ideal), a maker (methodology + extended voice work via the brand-writer agent), and an adversarial named-critic Council (check-brand-council, fanning out persona-inlined judge dispatches). User-invocable skills: make-brand, make-brand-muse, make-brand-guidelines, make-brand-stack, check-brand-orientation, check-brand-rubric, check-brand-council, file-brand, file-brand-corpus. Methodology/evaluation/corpus/guidelines knowledge are skills, cited by the procedures rather than restated. Portable across Claude Code/Cowork and a single-context Claude Project: a brand-corpus MCP gives per-instance retrieval, backed by a corpus-resolution ladder (MCP tools → filesystem → Claude Project knowledge) every procedure declares its own mode against — degrading to filesystem-only where bundled scripts are load-bearing, or an in-chat ledger elsewhere. Self-contained.

corpus_dir.title: Brand corpus directory
corpus_dir.description: Path to this brand's corpus (documents, tokens, strategy files) for the brand-corpus MCP. Optional — leave unset to run methodology, evaluation, and council without live corpus retrieval.
